memory_candidates.content: A standalone Lean snippet probe (lean_run_code) cannot surface same-namespace duplicate-declaration collisions with sibling modules that the library root aggregator also imports. A probe that declares `Foo.bar` without importing the sibling module that already declares `Foo.bar` compiles green; the same code inside a real module fails with "`Foo.bar` has already been declared" only once the root aggregator pulls both in. Before pinning a new declaration name in a Lean plan or report, grep the target namespace tree-wide for that exact name (not just the target file), or import the sibling and reuse. This specifically defeats the common recommendation to 'restate a small helper locally so the new module need not import X'.
